title: Stoker plugins — registry
description: `registry.yaml` at a plugin registry's root: who the registry is, the key its compiled index is signed with, which publishers it accepts and under which namespaces, and what it refuses. A Stoker host subscribes to a registry by its `url` and `key`; through it, the host trusts the publishers listed here, for their namespaces only.

name.description: A short name a host shows, and records on what it installs from the registry (`registry:<name>`).

url.description: Where the compiled index is served: `<url>/index/v1/timestamp.json`, `<url>/index/v1/plugins.json.zst`, `<url>/index/v1/plugins/<key>.json`.

key.description: The registry's public key, which signs `timestamp.json` (`timestamp.schema.json`).

publishers.description: Who may publish in this registry, with the key each version's `signature` is checked against and the key prefixes it owns. A prefix belongs to one publisher.

policy.description: What this registry refuses, whoever signed it. The public StokerHQ registry refuses `unpacker`, and integrations whose provider's check they would answer for a store.

mirrors.description: Places that keep copies of the registry's files by content: a file is at `<mirror>/<sha256[0:2]>/<sha256>`. A host tries them, in order, when a release asset is gone; the hash decides whether what it got is the file.

publicKey.description: An ECDSA P-256 public key: base64 of its DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo — the body of the PEM `-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----` block, on one line — as Stoker's release keys are written. Its id, which a host shows, is the first 8 bytes of the SHA-256 of those DER bytes, in lowercase hex.

namespaces.description: The key prefixes this publisher may publish under, each ending in a dot: `app.stokerhq.` owns `app.stokerhq.peacock`.
